tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Live price and 24h change for a crypto perp, stock, index, forex pair or metal. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_klines
tools.description: OHLC candles for a symbol. Use this to compute indicators or check a setup before trading.

tools.name: get_markets
tools.description: Every tradable symbol with its asset class, maximum leverage and taker fee. Call this before sizing a trade.

tools.name: get_screener
tools.description: Scored trade setups across top USDT perps: 0-100 technical score, RSI, MACD, funding and open interest.

tools.name: get_funding
tools.description: Current funding rates across exchanges - who pays whom to hold a perp position.

tools.name: get_open_interest
tools.description: Open interest per symbol - how much leveraged money is committed.

tools.name: get_liquidations
tools.description: Recent real liquidation events aggregated from nine exchanges.

tools.name: get_fear_greed
tools.description: Crypto Fear and Greed index, current value and classification.

tools.name: get_economic_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming macro events that move crypto (FOMC, CPI, NFP). Always check this before answering questions about dates - never answer those from memory.

tools.name: calc_liquidation
tools.description: Liquidation price for a position: entry, leverage, side.

tools.name: calc_position_size
tools.description: Risk-based position size from account balance, risk percent, entry and stop.

tools.name: paper_balance
tools.description: Your paper account: balance, equity, free margin, unrealized P&L. Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_positions
tools.description: Your paper positions with live mark price and P&L net of fees; status "open" for just the open ones. Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_trades
tools.description: Closed-trade ledger with paging - the full record for measuring a strategy. Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_open
tools.description: Open a simulated position at the live price. Simulated money only - no real funds are ever at risk. Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_close
tools.description: Close a simulated position, fully or partially. Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_sltp
tools.description: Move the stop-loss, take-profit or trailing stop on an open simulated position. Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_modify_order
tools.description: Change a resting limit or stop order in place: its price, stop-loss, take-profit, margin, leverage or trailing stop. Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_fees
tools.description: Which exchange fee schedule your paper fills are charged at: lists the venues we model (Bybit, Binance, OKX, Bitget, MEXC, Gate, KuCoin, Kraken, Hyperliquid) with their taker rate and the referral discount a MarginPad sign-up gets, and your current default. tools.name: paper_report
tools.description: The 30-day trading report for this account, measured from its own closed trades: totals and a skill score (free), win rate and return by coin, leverage band, side, hour and day plus written findings (API Pro and above). Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_accounts
tools.description: Every book (sub-account) of this account with lifetime numbers and the keys bound to it. A book is a separate journal, balance and report; a key minted with a book name trades that book. Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_reset
tools.description: Restart this key’s book at $10,000: closed trades are archived (never deleted), resting orders cancelled, the report and equity curve start from now. Refused while positions are open - close them first. Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_equity
tools.description: The equity curve of this key’s book: starting balance + realized P&L per bucket from the ledger, the live unrealized point at the end, and max drawdown. Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_replay
tools.description: Backtest with the real routes: replay one past UTC day on MarginPad’s 1-minute candles. tools.description: Place a resting order that fills only when the market reaches your price, and fills AT that price. type "limit" = a pullback entry (long below the market, short above); type "stop" = a breakout entry (long above the market, short below). To open right now use paper_open instead. Simulated money only

tools.name: paper_orders
tools.description: Your resting limit orders, plus the last 20 that filled, expired or were cancelled. Requires an API key.

tools.name: paper_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a resting limit order. Requires an API key.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_economic_calendar" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Upcoming macro events that move crypto (FOMC, CPI, NFP). Always check this before answering questions about dates - never answer those from memory.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_economic_calendar" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Upcoming macro events that move crypto (FOMC, CPI, NFP). Always check this before answering questions about dates - never answer those from memory.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "paper_realism" is 659 chars, far longer than this server's median (104). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
